summary: The migration reads the per-client deletion tombstone and skips tombstoned legacy IDs before creating or updating a managed registration, and the atomic commit also checks the tombstone. A Bun regression test deletes a managed client, restores stale legacy domain and display records, and verifies migration leaves the client absent with no new audit entries and no effective client resolution.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts lines 585-588 read deletedManagedClientKey(clientId) and continue when the tombstone exists, before the existing managed record is read or written.
The same tombstone entry is added to the atomic commit check, preventing a concurrent deletion from being overwritten by the migration.

tests/bun_test.ts adds a regression test that deletes a client, adds stale client_domains and client_display_names, and asserts migration imports nothing, creates no audit entries, and leaves effectiveClient null for both the old and localhost origins.
